reasoning: Upstream, ML Metadata (MLMD) is a Google library (pip-installable Python package plus C++/Go bindings) for recording ML workflow metadata. The RHOAI fork, however, only ships a container image. Both Konflux/Tekton pipelines build ml_metadata/tools/docker_server/Dockerfile.konflux into quay.io/rhoai/odh-mlmd-grpc-server-rhel9. That Dockerfile compiles the //ml_metadata/metadata_store:metadata_store_server Bazel target (metadata_store_server_main.cc, metadata_store_service_impl.cc) and runs it as a long-lived gRPC server on port 8080 (GRPC_PORT, io.openshift.expose-services=8080). The server stores metadata in a MySQL or PostgreSQL backend. In RHOAI it is deployed as the MLMD gRPC backend for Data Science Pipelines, so in this platform it is a service, even though the codebase can also be used as a library.
